record.name: Test and assemble a small material-bound canopy
record.function: Assess and construct a finite five-pole shade canopy from measured short materials, with actual grass trials, proof loads, exposure readings and maintenance.
record.costs: Exact IDs or one item:/object: prefix. Inspect/assess/exposure: one round/0.2 energy. Trial: one measured whole pole, one unaltered grass allocation >=0.1 unit, separate real weights; two stages/0.5 each. Assembly: first pole is ridge, next four legs, individually measured; positive explicit dimensions, 0.05 leg joint allowance, actual grass cover mass >=0.5 per roof area and six bindings >=0.02 mass each with personally passed source coupons; four stages/0.75 each. No splicing. Proof requires real load allocations; order names ridge midpoint, first end apex, second end apex, with conservative reaction envelope. Proof/dismantle: two stages/0.5 each. Repair replaces whole equal-quantity grass components in two stages/0.5 each, followed by two actual proof-load stages/0.5 each. Resume/cancel use only own project with empty target/components; unused dimensions zero. Trials use actual x/y layout and zero dimensions. Structure service uses target and zero dimensions. No energy/access means no progress or charge.
record.effects: Paid real geometry and conserved location-bound components; no supplied stock or automatic certification. Five poles form two triangular ends and a ridge; measured lengths bound all dimensions. Grass binding law 50 force per dry mass, wet factor 1–0.5, slip above half breaking force; actual apertures, wear 0.001 dry to 0.004 saturated per round. Explicit proof checks self/wet/wind/load weight, joints, bending, buckling, spread and sag. Conditional finite rays and actual body coverage reuse existing bounded thermal/rest effects and personal-refuge events. No assembly/mastery reward; informative paid trials/exposure use shared deduplicated understanding. Cancel/death releases only surviving unincorporated escrow once; installed parts and passive weathering persist.

execution.progress: Exact location-bound stages and paid effort; paused work resumes only remaining stages, completion cannot restart.

record.name: Tested woven assay supports
record.function: Test real branch and vine batches, fabricate a bark-free comparison balance and mesh from paid components, resume partial work, and calibrate for existing relative food-mass measurements.
record.costs: Tests: target owned branch/vine, controls one hardness>=8 stone, project a new personal ID. reviews.reason: The existing inspection exposes coupon condition but not the acceptance predicates that produced the retained failure. Consulting a contract or record does not provide this missing predicate-level diagnostic. Add a read-only explanation using the actual trial evaluator and its versioned rules. The recorded load of 1.962 exceeds half the reported breaking force (1.8), which is relevant to the declared slip mechanism, but the diagnostic must obtain the exact acceptance checks from implementation rather than infer a complete failure explanation from these numbers alone. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: This is an explanation of an already performed experience, not a new physical experiment or newly observed material response. It therefore grants no transient pleasure, maintained satisfaction, practice milestone or confirmed-understanding award. Do not emit information-confirmed or practice-confirmed from the diagnostic. Any later separately performed experiment remains subject to its existing event-grounded feedback rules; requesting, studying and reading this extension confer no reward.
reviews.visualReview: Display a predicate table with observed/model-derived provenance, values, units, thresholds and pass/fail/unknown indicators. Show the retained coupon identity and historical trial revision alongside a clear statement that the explanation neither changes the coupon nor certifies another configuration. Replay short-refuge-trial-diagnosed with the actual charged energy and diagnostic payload; do not render a new trial, material movement or passing badge.
reviews.specification: Extend short-material-refuge with mode diagnose-trial; record code reuse separately from this new diagnostic function. Public parameters retain the existing shared reference conventions: project is the exact own retained trial operation ID, target is an optional exact owned coupon ID or single item: prefix; components must be empty and all dimensions/coordinates zero. Require individual study of this extension and existing short-material-refuge mastery. One completed read action costs 0.2 energy, consumes no material, and requires no physical coupon access when the retained record suffices. Validate ownership and record identity before charging. Resolve the original evaluator revision and return every acceptance predicate, its expression, recorded operand values, threshold, comparison, pass/fail/unknown result and evidence lineage. Separate performed observations, model-derived quantities and assumptions; distinguish original trial state from subsequent coupon alterations. Explain parameter dependencies and executable parameter bounds supported by the actual schema, without recommending a future activity or certifying hypothetical configurations. Evaluate the original recorded outcome, not a new trial using current coupon integrity. If required historical inputs are absent, mark affected checks unknown and identify the missing evidence and any separately paid physical examination needed; never fabricate values. Persist a versioned diagnostic record linked to the original operation, coupon and evaluator revision. Execution is atomic: successful completion charges once and emits short-refuge-trial-diagnosed; unavailable energy pauses before payment, with one remaining read action. Cancellation or death terminates pending work without charge or output. There is no escrow, material transformation, geometry change, certificate or ongoing physical effect. Preserve existing trial histories and certificates; migrate legacy records by linking retained inputs and rule revisions, leaving unavailable fields explicitly unknown. Register the new event for subscription validation and bind its structured payload to the public diagnostic view and replay.
